## Key publications

See @tbl-pangeneu-pubs.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pangeneu-pubs
#| tbl-cap: "PanGenEU publications."
library(reactable)

pubs <- data.frame(
  Year    = c(2017, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2026),
  Authors = c("Gomez-Rubio et al.", "Gomez-Rubio et al.", "Molina-Montes et al.",
              "Michaud et al.", "Lu et al.", "He et al."),
  Theme   = c("Risk factors", "Risk factors", "Risk factors", "Genetics & omics",
              "Genetics & omics", "Risk factors"),
  Topic   = c("Multimorbidity patterns", "Asthma & nasal allergies",
              "Family history of cancer", "DNA methylation & inflammation",
              "miRNA-affecting variants", "Atopy (Mendelian randomization)"),
  Role    = c("Primary", "Primary", "Primary", "Replication", "Replication",
              "GWAS summary-level"),
  Journal = c("Ann Oncol", "Gut", "Int J Epidemiol", "CEBP", "Front Genet", "CEBP"),
  DOI     = c("10.1093/annonc/mdx167", "10.1136/gutjnl-2015-310442", "10.1093/ije/dyx269",
              "10.1158/1055-9965.EPI-20-0378", "10.3389/fgene.2021.693933",
              "10.1158/1055-9965.EPI-25-1601"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

reactable(pubs, filterable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE)
```
